summary: Reworked the eval display OpenSpec change to follow docs/frontend-eval-display-guide.md from main: classify manual vs optimizer eval runs, add status-aware history display, link optimizer baseline/round eval runs, and keep eval pool display aggregate-only.
assumptions: The guide exists on main at docs/frontend-eval-display-guide.md in commit b9a8a17, but this detached worktree at 9f180bb does not currently contain that file.
docs/frontend-optimizer-eval-link.md also exists on main and reinforces baseline_eval_run_id and rounds[].eval_run_id display behavior.
GET /evaluate/history does not expose source, so frontend source classification must cross-reference optimizer history until backend adds source: db | pool.
The guide recommends displaying eval pool aggregate stats, not raw eval_pool.json cases or raw test case logs as the main optimizer UI.
The original eval_json raw test-case-display assumption was replaced by the committed guide's actual requirements.
Graphify impact query was attempted but graphify-out/graph.json is absent in this workspace.
